descFull: Java ORM alternative to MyBatis & Hibernate: JPA-style CRUD + SQL-first queries. Dynamic conditions without <if> blocks; one SQL across 25 databases (auto dialect & function adaptation); self-optimizing pagination; cache translate (no dictionary JOINs); race-proof updateFetch ledgers; sharding, multi-tenancy, data masking. In production since 2008.
